Practised traditional ways of living with nature.
Gave examples involving Bishnoi, Chipko, and sacred groves.
Explained that protecting trees can help springs retain water in soil.
Connected neem leaves with keeping insects away from stored grain.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions recorded.
end.parentNote: Dev practised examples of nature-protecting traditions, including Bishnoi, Chipko, and sacred groves. They used cause-and-effect explanations for tree protection, springs, and neem leaves in grain storage. At first, some answers needed prompting, and Dev later gave a clearer explanation of neem keeping insects away. At home, ask Dev to explain one tradition and the science behind it using “because.”
